title: ModTGCN：基于模块度感知的图神经网络文本分类方法
summary: 提出ModTGCN模型，通过联合优化交叉熵和模块度辅助目标，在文本分类中利用文档图的全局社区结构，避免过平滑，并在五个基准上取得一致提升，训练速度提升2-10倍。
summary_en: Proposes ModTGCN, a modularity-aware GNN for text classification that jointly optimizes cross-entropy and a modularity-based auxiliary objective to leverage global community structure, achieving consistent gains on five benchmarks with 2x-10x faster training.
